scene: The brass tea robot bows politely and whistles a cheerful tune.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view along the market floor. The player in her red bomber jacket stands left, smiling at the brass tea robot in the centre. The robot holds out a steaming jade teacup, with a golden token sliding from its chest slot on the right. Up high, a cheerful propeller delivery drone hovers.
shown: a steaming jade teacup balanced on the robot's left tray, centre
a golden raffle token dispensed from the robot's chest slot, right
a small propeller drone carrying a bento box hovering up high

variants.scene: A friendly brass tea robot happily serves hot drinks beneath the glowing red lanterns.
Steam curls from fresh tea while the robot whistles {tune} on the lively platform.
